rows.title: What is CoinPort?
rows.content: CoinPort is an AUSTRAC-registered Australian cryptocurrency exchange that allows users to buy, sell, and trade digital assets securely. We provide a user-friendly platform with competitive fees, advanced trading tools, and 24/7 customer support.
rows.content_html: CoinPort is an AUSTRAC-registered Australian cryptocurrency exchange that allows users to buy, sell, and trade digital assets securely. We provide a user-friendly platform with competitive fees, advanced trading tools, and 24/7 customer support.

rows.title: Is CoinPort regulated in Australia?
rows.content: Yes. CoinPort Pty Ltd is registered with AUSTRAC as a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) — registration 100633359 and complies with AUSTRAC's requirements for anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorism financing (CTF).
rows.content_html: Yes. CoinPort Pty Ltd is registered with AUSTRAC as a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) — registration 100633359 and complies with AUSTRAC's requirements for anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorism financing (CTF).

rows.title: Which cryptocurrencies does CoinPort support?
rows.content: We support a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Litecoin (LTC), Ripple (XRP), and many others. For a full list of supported assets, visit our Research page.
rows.content_html: We support a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Litecoin (LTC), Ripple (XRP), and many others. For a full list of supported assets, visit our Research page.

rows.title: Can I use CoinPort outside Australia?
rows.content: Currently, CoinPort primarily serves Australian residents. Some features may be restricted for users outside Australia due to regulatory requirements.
rows.content_html: Currently, CoinPort primarily serves Australian residents. Some features may be restricted for users outside Australia due to regulatory requirements.

rows.title: How do I contact CoinPort support?
rows.content: You can reach us via: - Porter AI Chat Bot (24/7 first-level support) - Live Chat with our team (during Melbourne business hours) - Email: support@coinport.com.au We don't operate a manned phone line — chat and email are the fastest ways to reach us.
rows.content_html:
You can reach us via:

  • Porter AI Chat Bot (24/7 first-level support)
  • Live Chat with our team (during Melbourne business hours)
  • Email: support@coinport.com.au

We don't operate a manned phone line — chat and email are the fastest ways to reach us.

rows.title: How do I create a CoinPort account?
rows.content: 1. Visit CoinPort’s website and click "Sign Up." 2. Enter your email, create a password, and agree to the terms. 3. Verify your email via the confirmation link sent to your inbox. 4. Complete identity verification (KYC) to unlock full account features.
rows.content_html:
1. Visit CoinPort’s website and click "Sign Up."
  2. Enter your email, create a password, and agree to the terms.
  3. Verify your email via the confirmation link sent to your inbox.
  4. Complete identity verification (KYC) to unlock full account features.

rows.title: Why do I need to verify my identity (KYC)?
rows.content: As a regulated exchange, we must comply with Australian AML/CTF laws. Verification ensures security and prevents fraud.
rows.content_html: As a regulated exchange, we must comply with Australian AML/CTF laws. Verification ensures security and prevents fraud.

rows.title: What documents are required for verification?
rows.content: - Australian Users: - Government-issued ID (Passport, Driver’s License) - Proof of Address (Utility bill, Bank statement) - Non-Australian Users: - Passport + additional verification may be required
rows.content_html:
• Australian Users:
  • Government-issued ID (Passport, Driver’s License)
  • Proof of Address (Utility bill, Bank statement)
  • Non-Australian Users:
  • Passport + additional verification may be required

rows.title: How long does verification take?
rows.content: Most verifications are completed within 15–30 minutes. Delays may occur if documents are unclear or additional checks are needed.
rows.content_html: Most verifications are completed within 15–30 minutes. Delays may occur if documents are unclear or additional checks are needed.

rows.title: Can I have multiple CoinPort accounts?
rows.content: No, each user is allowed only one verified account. Duplicate accounts may be suspended.
rows.content_html: No, each user is allowed only one verified account. Duplicate accounts may be suspended.

rows.title: How do I deposit funds into my CoinPort account?
rows.content: You can deposit: - AUD via Bank Transfer (PayID, BSB/Account) - Cryptocurrency by sending assets to your CoinPort wallet address
rows.content_html:
You can deposit:

  • AUD via Bank Transfer (PayID, BSB/Account)
  • Cryptocurrency by sending assets to your CoinPort wallet address

rows.title: Are there deposit fees?
rows.content: - AUD Deposits: Free - Crypto Deposits: Network fees may apply (varies by blockchain)
rows.content_html:
• AUD Deposits: Free
  • Crypto Deposits: Network fees may apply (varies by blockchain)

rows.title: How long do deposits take?
rows.content: - AUD: Usually instant via Osko/PayID (under a minute), 24/7 including weekends - Crypto: Depends on network congestion (Bitcoin: ~10–30 mins, Ethereum: ~1–5 mins)
rows.content_html:
• AUD: Usually instant via Osko/PayID (under a minute), 24/7 including weekends
  • Crypto: Depends on network congestion (Bitcoin: ~10–30 mins, Ethereum: ~1–5 mins)

rows.title: How do I withdraw funds?
rows.content: 1. Navigate to "Withdraw" in your account. 2. Select AUD (Bank Transfer) or Cryptocurrency. 3. Enter the amount and destination details. 4. Confirm via 2FA (if enabled).
rows.content_html:
1. Navigate to "Withdraw" in your account.
  2. Select AUD (Bank Transfer) or Cryptocurrency.
  3. Enter the amount and destination details.
  4. Confirm via 2FA (if enabled).

rows.title: Are there withdrawal limits?
rows.content: Withdrawal limits depend on your verification level and are shown on the withdrawal page in your account. For higher limits, contact support.
rows.content_html: Withdrawal limits depend on your verification level and are shown on the withdrawal page in your account. For higher limits, contact support.

rows.title: What trading pairs are available on CoinPort?
rows.content: We offer AUD trading pairs (BTC/AUD, ETH/AUD, etc.) and crypto-to-crypto pairs (BTC/ETH, XRP/LTC, etc.).
rows.content_html: We offer AUD trading pairs (BTC/AUD, ETH/AUD, etc.) and crypto-to-crypto pairs (BTC/ETH, XRP/LTC, etc.).

rows.title: What are CoinPort’s trading fees?
rows.content: - There are no commissions or fees for crypto orders or trades on the CoinPort exchange platform. We try to make CoinPort as simple and transparent as possible. The price quoted is the price you receive. - Incentives available for high-volume traders.
rows.content_html:
• There are no commissions or fees for crypto orders or trades on the CoinPort exchange platform. We try to make CoinPort as simple and transparent as possible. The price quoted is the price you receive.
  • Incentives available for high-volume traders.

rows.title: Does CoinPort support limit orders and stop-loss?
rows.content: Yes, we support: - Market Orders - Limit Orders - Stop-Loss Orders
rows.content_html:
Yes, we support:

  • Market Orders
  • Limit Orders
  • Stop-Loss Orders

rows.title: Can I use APIs for automated trading?
rows.content: Yes, CoinPort provides a REST API and WebSocket API for developers.
rows.content_html: Yes, CoinPort provides a REST API and WebSocket API for developers.

rows.title: How does CoinPort protect my funds?
rows.content: - The majority of digital assets held in cold storage - Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) enforcement - Encrypted data transmission (SSL/TLS)
rows.content_html:
• The majority of digital assets held in cold storage
  • Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) enforcement
  • Encrypted data transmission (SSL/TLS)

rows.title: Should I enable 2FA?
rows.content: Yes! 2FA adds an extra layer of security. We recommend Google Authenticator or Authy.
rows.content_html: Yes! 2FA adds an extra layer of security. We recommend Google Authenticator or Authy.

rows.title: What should I do if my account is compromised?
rows.content: 1. Reset your password immediately. 2. Revoke any active sessions in account settings. 3. Contact support to freeze suspicious transactions.
rows.content_html:
1. Reset your password immediately.
  2. Revoke any active sessions in account settings.
  3. Contact support to freeze suspicious transactions.

rows.title: What is Porter AI?
rows.content: Porter is CoinPort’s AI-powered chat bot designed to provide instant customer support for common queries.
rows.content_html: Porter is CoinPort’s AI-powered chat bot designed to provide instant customer support for common queries.

rows.title: What can Porter AI help with?
rows.content: - Account verification - Deposit/withdrawal status - Trading fees & limits - Basic troubleshooting
rows.content_html:
• Account verification
  • Deposit/withdrawal status
  • Trading fees & limits
  • Basic troubleshooting

rows.title: Can Porter AI access my account?
rows.content: No, Porter cannot access personal account details or execute transactions.
rows.content_html: No, Porter cannot access personal account details or execute transactions.

rows.title: How do I escalate to a human agent?
rows.content: Type "Human support" or "Live agent" in the chat, and Porter will connect you.
rows.content_html: Type "Human support" or "Live agent" in the chat, and Porter will connect you.

rows.title: Is CoinPort compliant with Australian tax laws?
rows.content: Yes, we provide tax reports for users to simplify crypto tax filings.
rows.content_html: Yes, we provide tax reports for users to simplify crypto tax filings.

rows.title: How does CoinPort handle AML regulations?
rows.content: We monitor transactions and may request additional details for large or suspicious activity.
rows.content_html: We monitor transactions and may request additional details for large or suspicious activity.

rows.title: Where can I find CoinPort’s Terms of Service?
rows.content: View our Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy on our website.

rows.title: My deposit hasn’t arrived. What should I do?
rows.content: - Check blockchain explorer for crypto deposits. - For AUD delays, contact your bank or our support team.

  • For AUD delays, contact your bank or our support team.

rows.title: Why was my withdrawal rejected?
rows.content: Possible reasons: - Insufficient funds - Incorrect wallet address - Security hold (contact support)

Possible reasons:

rows.content: - Clear browser cache/cookies - Try a different browser or device
